notes.title: Heavy Recoil speedrunning tournament results
notes.notes: Steam users WHAT IS A MAN! and Quagsire? fought head-to-head in today's Heavy Recoil speedrunning tournament. They competed simultaneously to complete the game as fast as possible (any%), with WHAT IS A MAN! barely beating out Quagsire? with a 6:24, beating his previous world record of 6:07.
